pool: 2025-published CVEs; publication-month end; exclude prior KEV from catalog or snapshot flag

seed_stability.policy: If any seed falls below the rule at either budget on either required split, average all five probabilities before applying the tier policy.
seed_stability.randomness: Refit both randomized training-only PCA and LightGBM; no row or feature subsampling is enabled.
seed_stability.limitation: Seed variability measures fitting randomness, not new-data uncertainty or model-selection optimism.

selection.rule: Pass all four baseline gates, maximize total margin, then within one point of the best total prefer IBM Granite embeddings and finally simplicity
selection.simplicity_order: Within the one-point margin window, prefer Granite embeddings, then rule over logistic over trees, fewer features, no blend and no tier policy
selection.warning: Development comparisons; test-year model selection is optimistic. H2 overlaps the primary test.

scaling.note: Literal 500 is also shown. Monthly budgets partition 500 by cohort size; not 500 per month.

censoring.note: Primary includes censored late rows for seed comparability; mature and fixed-90-day results are separate. December has zero follow-up.

uncertainty.limitation: Only 12 months; does not include model selection or retraining uncertainty.
